disclaimer.title: Data Disclaimer
body: {{app.name}} publishes geospatial information for planning, operations, and public awareness.
Maps and statistics are provided as-is. Always confirm critical decisions with the responsible institution and the source application’s own refresh time.

privacy.title: Privacy
body: This portal uses your account to sign you in and to load mapping applications you are authorised to view.
Session details stay on this origin. Do not share your username or password.

terms.title: Terms of Use
body: Use this portal for official and lawful purposes only. Do not attempt to bypass access controls or scrape restricted layers.
Content remains the property of {{organization.legalName}} and its partner institutions.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
body: Pages are built for keyboard use and common assistive technologies. Mapping viewers follow the accessibility of the source ArcGIS application.
If a page or map is hard to use, contact the institution listed in the footer.
